name: Fitness Tracker
description: This project develops a fitness application aimed at helping users track their physical activities, monitor progress, set fitness goals, and receive personalized workout recommendations. This app is designed to cater to both fitness enthusiasts and beginners, providing valuable tools and insights to support their fitness journey.
rawDescription: This project develops a fitness application aimed at helping users track their physical activities, monitor progress, set fitness goals, and receive personalized workout recommendations. This app is designed to cater to both fitness enthusiasts and beginners, providing valuable tools and insights to support their fitness journey.
highLevelGoals: Provide a comprehensive activity tracking system to help users monitor their workouts and performance over time.
Allow users to define personalized fitness goals and track their progress toward achieving them.
Offer tailored workout plans based on user preferences, fitness level, and progress to enhance engagement and effectiveness.
Provide step-by-step onboarding and beginner-friendly workout suggestions to help users start and stay motivated.
Design an easy-to-use interface that accommodates both experienced and novice users without overwhelming them.
lowLevelGoals: Allow the user to log details of a completed workout including duration, intensity, and equipment used.
Display graphs and charts showing progress metrics such as calories burned, distance covered, or workout frequency.
Enable users to define specific, measurable goals such as weight loss targets or weekly workout frequency.
Provide real-time updates and notifications when users approach or exceed their goal thresholds.
Create a customized workout schedule based on user’s fitness level, preferences, and past performance.
Suggest new exercises or adjust existing plans as the user’s fitness level improves or plateaus.
Guide new users through the app’s core features with interactive walkthroughs or video demonstrations.
Recommend low-intensity, easy-to-follow exercises suitable for users with no prior fitness experience.
Implement a minimalistic, distraction-free interface with large buttons and clear navigation for beginners.
Allow users to toggle between simplified and detailed views, adjust chart granularity, or hide non-essential elements.

baselineCritiques.actors: The actors "Fitness Enthusiast" and "Beginner" are well-defined and representative of the target users for a fitness application. However, there is an important omission: the system itself (e.g., the fitness app) should also be considered as an actor if it interacts with external systems or performs automated tasks (e.g., sending notifications, processing data). Additionally, a "Coach" or "Fitness Trainer" role could be relevant if the app provides personalized coaching services.
baselineCritiques.highLevelGoals: The high-level goals are well-defined and align with the software description, covering key functional aspects such as activity tracking, goal setting, personalized recommendations, onboarding for beginners, and user interface design. No contradictions or omissions were detected.
baselineCritiques.lowLevelGoals: The low-level goals are well-aligned with the high-level goals and accurately reflect the functional requirements of the fitness application. All branches address specific actions for both actors (Fitness Enthusiast and Beginner) without introducing contradictions or omissions. The goals cover tracking, goal setting, recommendations, onboarding, and UI design comprehensively.

hlg_7a7c9f5728034832_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable users to log workout session data and visualize activity trends over time through graphical representations of progress metrics.
hlg_7a7c9f5728034832_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to record detailed workout session data including duration, intensity, and equipment used. llg_002 adds the capability to visualize activity trends over time using graphs and charts for metrics like calories burned, distance covered, or workout frequency. Together, they form a complete scope of logging and visualizing fitness data, with no inferred or generalized functionality beyond these two distinct capabilities.

hlg_0fb0dc543542f24e_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable users to define personalized fitness goals and track their progress with real-time alerts and notifications.
hlg_0fb0dc543542f24e_001.rationale: llg_001 enables users to define specific, measurable fitness goals such as weight loss targets or workout frequency; llg_002 enables real-time progress tracking with alerts, which complements goal definition by providing feedback mechanisms. Together, they form a complete scope of goal-setting and monitoring, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.

hlg_8d667b8f3c5217c4_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Generate and dynamically adapt personalized workout plans based on user fitness level, preferences, past performance, and ongoing progress.
hlg_8d667b8f3c5217c4_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to generate an initial personalized workout plan based on user’s fitness level, preferences, and past performance. llg_002 adds the capability to recommend workouts and adjust existing plans as the user’s fitness level improves or plateaus — indicating a dynamic, iterative adaptation capability that extends beyond static plan generation.

hlg_3b3cb63beecf40e0_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Onboard new users and guide them through beginner-friendly fitness activities using interactive tutorials and personalized workout suggestions.
hlg_3b3cb63beecf40e0_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to guide new users through core app features via interactive walkthroughs or videos, while llg_002 adds the capability to recommend low-intensity, beginner-appropriate workouts. Together, they form a complete scope of user onboarding and initial activity guidance, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.

hlg_b2b4ce58b73e128a_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide a dual-mode user interface that supports both novice and expert users through distinct visual configurations and interactive controls.
hlg_b2b4ce58b73e128a_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to design a simplified UI for new users, focusing on minimalism and ease of navigation. llg_002 adds the capability to enable advanced customization for experienced users, including toggling views and adjusting chart granularity — which introduces a materially different user experience and control scope than llg_001. Together, they define a dual-mode interface with distinct lifecycle phases and actor-specific configurations, with no inferred missing functionality.
